item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud dbang drag bzlog gzhung srid gsum g.yul bzlogs
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan ces pa'i lcags mo phag lo'i zla tshes nyin pa la/ sbas pa'i rong bzhi shar phyogs gnas chen ri yi byang phyogs/ ke ta brag chen ces nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas/ rigs mthun karma mu dra bde ldan ma'i grogs bcas te/ zab mo khrom gter du bgyis shing / slar zla tshes kyi bsod nams can sa skyongs pho brang chen po drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse nas shog ser bod yig du (tu) phab grub pab gyis so//
